'''''Exar Kun: The Lesson, The Warning''''' was a text written by members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Written sometime after the end of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] between Kun's [[Brotherhood of the Sith]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> in [[3996 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the text was included in a list of suggested documents for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] to peruse during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], more than three [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] after the war.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Exar Kun: The Lesson, The Warning'' was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
